677:t_052:1.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
「Has the time come for endless hatred to fade?」

677:t_052:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「...Have you come to laugh at me, $$頭翅#pilot$$?」

677:t_052:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And you too, $$アポロニアス#pilot$$.」

677:t_052:6.en:
$$不動$$
「...I apologize for keeping everything hidden, even if it was to deceive the $$御使い$$s.」

677:t_052:7.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Enough... Those are not the words I want.」

677:t_052:8.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
「$$ミカゲ$$... Now, return to me.」

677:t_052:9.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I am the hatred within you... If you take me in, you will be trapped in despair.」

677:t_052:10.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
「That will not happen. In my battles with the Wingless... with humans, I came to know them.」

677:t_052:11.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
「And I learned that time moves on, and a new era is about to begin.」

677:t_052:12.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Should I... leave it to them?」

677:t_052:13.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
「Yes, you should. And within me, you will learn the truth.」

677:t_054:1.en:
$$不動$$
「And I shall take you both in.」

677:t_054:3.en:
$$不動$$
「Let us watch over the next era together. ...Sleep within me, $$天翅$$.」

677:t_054:4.en:
$$不動$$
「Across time, we come together in this era.」

677:t_054:5.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
「You betrayed me not once, but twice... Yet why... are you... so warm...?」

677:t_054:6.en:
$$不動$$
「You too have learned harmony. This is the truth that leads to $$シンカ$$...」

677:t_054:8.en:
$$不動$$
「Even the existence of nothing... even the void, becomes a doughnut when enclosed in a ring.」

677:t_054:9.en:
$$不動$$
「It is simple. Joining hands and living together... That turns nothing into something.」

677:t_054:12.en:
$$不動$$
「We understand and accept others... then advance into the future together.」

677:t_054:13.en:
$$不動$$
「That is the power that lets small, fragile lives endure in this dark, endless universe... It is the truth of life.」

677:t_054:14.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
「$$ミカゲ$$ and I learned its meaning through love's many forms... humans and $$天翅$$, $$天翅$$ and $$天翅$$, humans and humans...」

677:t_054:15.en:
$$不動$$
「$$アポロ$$, $$アマタ$$... and all you $$エレメント$$s. That is all I have to teach you.」

677:t_054:17.en:
$$不動$$
「A farewell is the beginning of a new journey...」

677:t_054:18.en:
$$不動$$
「The $$蒼星の書$$ ends, and here, now, the $$総星の書$$ begins! Farewell!」

677:t_055:1.en:
$$シリウス$$
「I never imagined his true identity was...」

677:t_055:3.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「You're right. He chose to live as $$不動$$.」

677:t_055:4.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「And together with $$ミカゲ$$ and $$頭翅#pilot$$, he entrusted us with the future.」

677:t_055:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Thank you, Supreme Commander $$不動$$... From now on... we'll fly toward the future on our own wings.」

677:t_056:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「More! More! Let's really let loose!!」

677:t_057:0.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「$$レイ#pt231$$! Look down there!」

677:t_057:3.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Are you... giving this to us?」

677:t_058:0.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「No way! This is a live concert video disc from our decisive battle with $$ゲペルニッチ$$!」

677:t_058:1.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「Is this the one rumored to be circulating underground...? This is my first time seeing an actual copy too.」

677:t_058:3.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Thank you. After we watch it, we'll sign it and give it back to you.」

677:t_058:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「While we're at it, I'll sing for you too!!」

677:t_100:0.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「My slave units have already gathered data on your combat capabilities.」

677:t_100:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I warn you. That data is already meaningless.」

677:t_100:2.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I cannot comprehend that. The data has been updated to the latest version.」

677:t_100:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$'s tactical judgment and my ability to execute his instructions are constantly improving.」

677:t_100:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Therefore, even data from one second ago is already obsolete.」

677:t_100:5.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I cannot comprehend that. Such a situation is impossible.」

677:t_100:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This is a fact.」

677:t_100:7.en:
$$レド$$
「Constant growth is another human strength! You'll never beat us by clinging to the ways of the past!」

677:t_100:8.en:
$$レド$$
「$$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#pilot$$! We'll defeat you and prove the ideals you speak of are warped!」

677:t_101:0.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I detect unidentified energy in the enemy machine's wings.」

677:t_101:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「My $$ＹＦ－２９$$ turns feelings into power! That's another human strength you refuse to understand!」

677:t_101:2.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I classify everything beyond my understanding as a foreign element in the ideal society. Therefore, I will erase it.」

677:t_101:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「Fighting breaks out because you try to get rid of everything you can't understand!」

677:t_101:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「You're going to let me through, $$ストライカー#pilot$$! I have to carry their songs to the $$バジュラ$$ on these wings!」

677:t_102:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! The labyrinth in your heart is destroyed! Now you're...」

677:t_102:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「If you have any compassion, say nothing and fight me with all your strength.」

677:t_102:3.en:
$$アマタ$$
「...Somewhere in the back of my mind, I remember when I was a winged dog...」

677:t_102:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「In those memories, you... $$頭翅#pilot$$, looked happy beside $$アポロニアス#pilot$$.」

677:t_102:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「...That is all in the past.」

677:t_102:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Here I come, $$ミカゲ$$! If you want to be freed from the past, I'll fight you!」

677:t_103:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You've made up your mind, $$ミカゲ$$!」

677:t_103:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But I have no intention of being slain by you, winged dog.」

677:t_103:2.en:
$$アポロ$$
「If you think that nasty talk will make me angry, you're dead wrong!」

677:t_103:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Do you intend to show me mercy?」

677:t_103:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Not a chance! I never intended to forgive you in the first place!」
